minecraft:written_book_content.title: Archive Fragment
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Archivist
pages: {"text":"The final pages were removed. The index still lists a witness who was never admitted."}
{"text":"The shelves are not arranged by date. They are arranged by the order in which people disappeared."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The crypt ledger lists names that also appear in the facility's missing-person register. Several entries were dated before the facility was built."}
